artifact_types.title: Per-Cell Vector Artifact
artifact_types.description: Promoted per-cell scalar/categorical vector such as pseudotime, labels, entropy, or module score.

artifact_types.title: Per-Cell Vector Family Artifact
artifact_types.description: Promoted keyed family of per-cell vectors, for example UCell signatures or chromVAR deviations.

artifact_types.title: Relation Family Artifact
artifact_types.description: Promoted sparse long-form cell-to-key relations such as branch membership.

artifact_types.title: 2D Path Family Artifact
artifact_types.description: Promoted 2D trajectory or lineage curves.

artifact_types.title: Space Path Family Artifact
artifact_types.description: Promoted high-dimensional route/trajectory paths.

artifact_types.title: 2D Space Artifact
artifact_types.description: Promoted reference to a 2D bundle space.

artifact_types.title: Model Reference Artifact
artifact_types.description: Promoted model reference for projection or method-specific reuse.
artifact_types.use_when: reuse fitted UMAP or trajectory models

artifact_types.title: Wilcoxon DE Table
artifact_types.description: Feature-level differential expression/accessibility statistics.

artifact_types.title: Top Marker Table
artifact_types.description: Top-ranked marker features per group.

artifact_types.title: Feature Trend Spearman Table
artifact_types.description: Feature-level association with a continuous vector such as pseudotime.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory DE Table
artifact_types.description: Feature-level differential or dynamic statistics along trajectory lineages.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Branch Compare Table
artifact_types.description: Feature-level branch comparison statistics.

artifact_types.title: Derived Cell-Set Manifest
artifact_types.description: Lifecycle manifest for a named derived cell set, including role, status, counts, recipe availability, source summary, and derivation metadata.

artifact_types.title: Derived Cell-Set Rule Table
artifact_types.description: Ordered per-rule audit table for a derived cell set, including input/output counts and selector/source fields.
use_when: explain why cells entered or left an analysis universe

artifact_types.title: Feature-Set Import Summary
artifact_types.description: Summary counts for a feature-set library import into bundle namespaces.

artifact_types.title: Feature-Set Import Manifest
artifact_types.description: One row per parsed feature set with namespace, collection, mapped-gene counts, status, and source metadata.

artifact_types.title: Rejected Feature-Set Import Table
artifact_types.description: Feature sets rejected during import, typically because no source genes mapped to the target matrix.

artifact_types.title: Feature-Set Matrix Overlap QC
artifact_types.description: Per-set raw, mapped, detected, duplicate, and include/exclude screening metrics against a matrix.
use_when: filter feature sets before trajectory dynamics
measure matrix coverage of gene-set libraries

artifact_types.title: Feature-Set Namespace Overlap Summary
artifact_types.description: Namespace-level overlap QC summary for imported feature-set libraries.

artifact_types.title: Feature-Set Transfer Summary
artifact_types.description: Summary of matrix-scoped feature-set namespace transfer between comparable matrices.

artifact_types.title: Feature-Set Transfer Manifest
artifact_types.description: One row per source feature set transferred or rejected between source and target matrices.
use_when: audit retained and dropped members after matrix transfer

artifact_types.title: Rejected Feature-Set Transfer Table
artifact_types.description: Feature sets rejected during matrix namespace transfer because retained target members failed thresholds.

artifact_types.title: Pathway Enrichment Table
artifact_types.description: Pathway or gene-set enrichment summary.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Smooth Curve Table
artifact_types.description: Binned/smoothed per-gene expression curves along trajectory pseudotime.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Signature Smooth Table
artifact_types.description: Smoothed signature/module curves along trajectory pseudotime.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Gene-Set Curve Table
artifact_types.description: Gene-set scores over pseudotime bins.
use_when: find gene sets that turn on or off

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Gene-Set Dynamics Table
artifact_types.description: One row per gene set with dynamics metrics and curve class.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Gene-Set Driver Table
artifact_types.description: Top member genes contributing to dynamic gene-set behavior.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Gene-Set Driver Curves
artifact_types.description: Driver-gene curves for selected dynamic gene sets.
artifact_types.use_when: show which genes drive a dynamic term

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Signal Curve Table
artifact_types.description: Precomputed signal/vector-family curves over pseudotime.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Signal Dynamics Table
artifact_types.description: Dynamics metrics and classes for precomputed signals.
artifact_types.use_when: rank dynamic UCell or chromVAR signals

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Segment Manifest
artifact_types.description: Audit manifest for one formal trajectory segment, including source kind, source engine, membership rule, normalization rule, parent artifacts, and caveats.
use_when: trace curated or space-path bridge assumptions

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Segment-Local Membership Table
artifact_types.description: One row per cell per parent segment preserving local pseudotime, scaled local pseudotime, lineage weight, and waypoint role.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Segment Join Manifest
artifact_types.description: Manifest for a segmented composite trajectory, recording parent trajectory_fit_ids, artifact IDs, biological labels, join policy, and overlap counts.

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Segment Path Join Manifest
artifact_types.description: Manifest for a derived segmented composite display path, recording parent path artifacts, segment order, point ranges, trajectory_fit_ids, and display-geometry caveats.
use_when: explain that a displayed composite curve is derived geometry, not a merged model

artifact_types.title: Trajectory Display Path Endpoint QC
artifact_types.description: Endpoint-distance diagnostics comparing display path start/end points with declared endpoint cell-set or coordinate descriptors.
use_when: detect stale or mismatched trajectory display paths
audit display geometry against declared endpoint cell sets
decide whether trajectory curve figures can be trusted

artifact_types.title: UCell Signature Summary
artifact_types.description: Summary statistics for UCell signature scores.

artifact_types.title: Cell Vector Winner Table
artifact_types.description: Per-cell winner, runner-up, confidence, and pruning metrics from a cell_vector_family.

artifact_types.title: Cell Vector Family Graph Smoothing Summary
artifact_types.description: Per-key diagnostics for nearest-neighbor smoothing of a cell_vector_family over a bundle space.
use_when: check smoothing parameters and score shifts

artifact_types.title: Cell Vector Association Summary
artifact_types.description: Typed association result with dispatched method, effect size, and validity diagnostics.

artifact_types.title: Cell Vector Association Contingency
artifact_types.description: Observed and expected counts for categorical-by-categorical cell-vector association.

artifact_types.title: Cell Vector Association Cells
artifact_types.description: Per-cell values used in a continuous-by-continuous association.

artifact_types.title: Winner Cell-Set Manifest
artifact_types.description: One row per registered winner-derived bundle cell set.

artifact_types.title: chromVAR Motif Summary
artifact_types.description: Summary statistics for chromVAR motif deviations.

artifact_types.title: KNN Neighbor Table
artifact_types.description: Cell-neighbor relationships from a KNN graph/query.

artifact_types.title: KNN Pseudobulk Feature Table
artifact_types.description: Feature summaries over KNN neighborhoods.

artifact_types.title: Matrix Log-Normalization Summary
artifact_types.description: Summary of a persisted log-normalized matrix transform, including source matrix, output matrix, scale factor, dimensions, and library-size diagnostics.
use_when: choose a reusable expression matrix for downstream ops
